panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Implied ±13.2% vs realised mean 8.5%/median 7.3%; base case realised probably 8-12%, roughly fairly priced given the real fat tail (34.65% short, 9.65 days to cover, a +20.8% precedent).
panel_verdicts.strongest_reversal_case: Most direct evidence the bear case is already discounted is the last print itself: Q4 revenue down 52.5% YoY plus a weak FY27 guide only moved the stock -1.21% -- sellers are exhausted. 34.65% of float short, 9.65 days to cover, EV of only $1.09bn vs $673M cash. Q1 is historically a reaffirm quarter, not a cut quarter; an in-line print with a reaffirmed FY27 range and a loss beat is enough to force multi-day covering.
panel_verdicts.what_would_break_my_reversal_case: Siebel trimming or declining to reaffirm the FY27 $210-240M range, revenue below the $50M guide floor, or free cash burn worse than Q4's -$54.8M
key_drivers: Extreme, mechanically squeezable short base: 34.65% of float, 9.65 days to cover, EV just $1.09bn vs $673M cash
Guide already reset to the floor; FY27 back-half loaded so Q1 is a reaffirm quarter
Offsetting: stock already ran ~11-15% on sector sympathy not company news; Siebel's August sale was a 10b5-1 seller, not a fresh buyer
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: FY27 guide requires H2 acceleration while the sales org is being rebuilt -- if Siebel pre-empts that risk by cutting the range, the squeeze thesis inverts
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Could not source current borrow fee, Q1 RPO/bookings consensus; short interest figures differ slightly by vendor (32.4% vs 34.65%) but point the same way

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Expect a move at or above ±13.2% implied, not below it. Historical set splits: prints preceded by a preliminary-results 8-K produced small moves (already leaked); clean un-preannounced prints produced +20.76%/-18.53%/-9.68%. This quarter has no preannouncement, so implied is fair-to-slightly-cheap versus the ~16% mean of the un-preannounced subset.
key_drivers: No preliminary-results 8-K this quarter from a management team 2-for-2 on preannouncing misses -- argues the quarter landed inside the $50-54M guide

Operating KPIs (agreement counts, partner deals, pipeline growth) quietly removed from the Q4 release; named-customer PR cadence down to one announcement vs ~five in the year-ago window -- business forensics deteriorating even if this print clears

Insider activity is routine 10b5-1 selling only (Siebel, CFO), no open-market buying anywhere including through the March drawdown to $7.73; positioning loaded against bears with ~32% of float short and a +64% call-volume spike on 21-Aug
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Absence of a preannouncement may mean nothing (both priors were bundled with leadership news); even a clean beat is erased if the FY27 $210-240M guide is reaffirmed or cut instead of raised -- the dead PR cadence and KPI removal look exactly like a company about to cut guidance
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No live borrow fee or fresh short-interest settlement date; PR-cadence counts from a single paginated newsroom fetch, may undercount but direction is clear; 10b5-1 plan date is snippet_only from a secondary source

synthesis.move_band_note: unsigned magnitude band, right-skewed; the implied move is roughly one standard deviation, not a cap
synthesis.early_prediction: Panel leans mildly bearish (consensus -10) on continued fundamental deterioration and a rich implied move, but the lean does not clear a directional bar: a large, mechanically squeezable short base (~32-35% of float) is flagged by both the red-team and forensics personas as the dominant tail risk, cutting against the consensus lean as much as confirming any bear thesis -- hence Neutral / No Edge, not a suppressed Lean Down.
synthesis.red_team_survival_note: The panel's mild bearish tilt does not survive the red-team case comfortably. Red-team's reversal_risk (68) is tied for the panel's highest, and its argument is specific and sourced, not just contrarian pessimism: 34.65% of float short, 9.65 days to cover, and the precedent that Q4's materially worse miss (-52.5% YoY revenue) only moved the stock -1.21%, i.e. sellers already exhausted at a lower bar than this one. The forensics persona independently corroborates the mechanical-squeeze read (call-volume +64% on 21-Aug) while still leaning net bullish (+12) on the absence of a preliminary-results 8-K -- two personas working different lenses converge on the same reversal risk from different evidence, which is why reversal risk stayed High even though the panel itself is 'aligned' by the disparity metric.
synthesis.independence_caveat: Options-positioning and red-team both cite stockanalysis.com/stocks/ai/statistics/ for the short-interest/days-to-cover figures; this is a common public aggregator for a single data point, not a shared thesis, so no certainty adjustment was made.

independence_note: Seven isolated subagents; each received only the Phase-0 anchors. The forensics seat ran long (~5min vs ~3min for the others) but returned a valid verdict before the panel was finalised.
